name: Gobernación del Cauca
body: Every page read has a title and a description, every internal link opened answered, and unknown paths answer 404. But the search field on pages like the cabinet list has no label for screen readers.
lesson: Give each field a <label for> or aria-label so screen readers say what to type.
summary: www.cauca.gov.co scores 74 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 25 are at risk, and 12 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 30 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /LaGobernacion/Paginas/Gabinete.aspx, /LaGobernacion/Paginas/mapa-de-procesos.aspx. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 38 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 2 titles are shared by more than one page
fix.evidence: "Nuestra Gestión" on /NuestraGestion/Paginas/Transparencia-y-Acceso-a-la-Informacion.aspx, /NuestraGestion/Paginas/Normativa-escala-salarial.aspx, /NuestraGestion/Paginas/estructura-organica.aspx and 1 more. "La Gobernación" on…
fix.fix: Write a title that names what is different about each page.

fix.title: 93 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http does not serve the site
The start page declares its language
Every page has a meta description
